text:
mika: Quick idea — midweek unwind this Wed after 6? There's a small taproom 6 blocks from the office that does ramen and has an outdoor picnic setup. Could do a tiny boardgame swap (bring a game, take a different one) + quick 30m social. Who's up for it? :beers: :ramen:

jamal: I'm in. Can bring Codenames and a travel chess set. :+1:

priya: Love it — in, but heads up I'm vegetarian. Any veg ramen options at the taproom?

carlos: @priya they have a veggie bowl last time I checked. Also can bring dice/cards for a mini Uno tourney.

lena: Curious — is this all OOO time or should we try to make it partly on company time? small stipend? :thinking_face:

mika: Good Q — aiming for 6:15pm so it's after typical hours. I can ask People Ops about a $10 snack stipend for attendees, but plan for self-pay if we don't get approval.

ops-bot: FYI — quick expense check: submit a "team-social" form at https://redwood.internal/expenses and tag #lunch-plans. Approval usually 24-48h.

jamal: sounds good. I'll RSVP if mika posts a tiny poll (prefer quick yes/no).

mika: ok doing a 1-question poll — vote 👍 if you can make it Wed 6:15, 🙏 if Thu 6:15, or ❌ if neither. I'll DM People Ops about the stipend after we gauge headcount.

priya: 👍

carlos: 👍

lena: 🙏

jamal: 👍

mika: great — looks like Wed wins for most. I'll add a calendar invite and pin the meetup details in this thread. Also tag any remote folks who want to drop by later. :sparkles:

carlos: Bringing portable speaker and a tiny 2-player game pack. low-key only. :video_game:

priya: thanks — excited. can someone save a veg bowl for me if it fills up? :pray:

mika: will do. If People Ops okays stipend I'll post instructions. See y'all Wed!
